definition: `NecessaryExistence F ex x w`: at w, every essence of x in the 1970 sense (DEF-ESSENCE-GOEDEL-1970) is exemplified by an existing individual at every world accessible from w (AFP definition NecExist, E x ≡ ❙∀φ. φ Ess. x ❙⊃ ❙□(❙∃⇧Ex. φ x)). Since the empty property is an essence of everything, an individual has it at w only if no world is accessible from w. Not Scott's NE (DEF-NECESSARY-EXISTENCE-SCOTT), not the tertia via's necessary being and not logical necessity.
